name: nepali-arc-c-2.5k
description: A Nepali-language version of the ARC Challenge dataset containing approximately 2.5k multiple-choice science questions. It measures a model's ability to answer grade-school to middle-school science questions in Nepali, testing reasoning and domain knowledge in a low-resource language. The dataset is intended to evaluate multilingual and Indic-language models on science question answering.
reputation: Part of the Indic-Benchmark suite used to evaluate multilingual and Indic-language models; moderately used by researchers working on low-resource NLP.
